verdict.rationale: A data-use or privacy posture on AI training is a fair question for any service that holds user-submitted data, including a government filing portal, so the axis applies. The pack has no policy, opt-out, or statement about AI-model training. User Access filing controls and bot-management walls are adjacent access controls, not a training opt-out, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
